$comment: When and how to use the Switch. The component is src/styles/components/switch.css, built from Figma "Foundation – UI 2" (Switch page 42:20, component set 44:71). Shown on the Switch page and published to public/llms.txt by `npm run tokens`.
intro: Represent a physical toggle to turn a setting “on” or “off”. Unlike checkboxes, toggling a switch takes immediate effect without a need for additional confirmation steps (“save”).

states.label: Off
states.usage: Knob on the left over a --color-bg-hover track. aria-checked="false".

states.label: On
states.usage: Knob slides right over a --color-bg-inverse track. aria-checked="true".

rules: Use
Use a switch only for settings that apply immediately (theme, notifications). If the change waits for Save or Submit, use a checkbox.
Every switch needs a name: a visible label linked with aria-labelledby, or an aria-label when the context makes it obvious.
Name the setting, not the action: “Dark theme”, not “Turn dark theme on”. Don't add On/Off text next to the switch.
In a settings row, put the label first and the switch at the end of the row.
